evidence: All 28 criteria (2 gates, 16 functional, 6 polish, 4 visual) were read in full; none enumerates requirements and then waives most of them. Every binary criterion ends in one conjunctive bar ('Assign 1 only if every check holds' render gate L32-33; multi-part functional criteria say 'Both/All parts must hold'; functional prompt.md L26-33 and polish prompt.md L23-25 state that every named step must hold and the 'Fails if' line never excuses an unmentioned leg). Instances that look like waivers were each checked and resolve to a single bar: (1) constraints gate 'This gate does not grade roles, correctness, or feature completeness' (constraints judge.toml L68-70) only scopes away things the criterion never lists; (2) wall_every_route leg 5 JUDGE-W3 (functional L66-67) permits two explicit outcomes (refused, or filed under its own M-13 parent) with one invariant, 'must never appear in M-11 or under a message of another matter', matching walls-and-retention.md; (3) the conditional earlier-versions steps in timer_changes (L138, L140) and persistence (L276) state that the viewer is graded in edits_and_stale_edit, which requires it (L172). The deletion of the earlier version is still covered by search and transcript evidence ('neither 2,400 nor 4,200'), so the bar is the same with or without the viewer; (4) the request-recording conditionals in wall_mentions_and_links Part B ('If showing the suggestions made a request, record it') and edits_and_stale_edit Part A step 3 ('if the request carries a version') adapt to implementation shape and do not drop a requirement; (5) visual matter_sidebar (visual judge.toml L170) conditionally removes one of three anchor-5 elements: 'If no matter shows an unread count when you look, judge identification and selection only.' This is a Note rather than a defect. The condition can be observed, it removes one element rather than most, and it fits the visual prompt rule that a functional shortcoming must not lower a visual score (visual prompt.md L13-16). The judge therefore has one bar for each observed state. Lower anchors 4-1 do not mention counts, which is consistent. Flow-bundled conjunctive criteria (e.g. signin_and_client_scope, search_and_transcript) are the known false positive the SKILL lists for check 33 and the Internal sheet annotation endorses. Whether to split them for independent credit belongs to rows 26/28, not to this row. Broken-app probe: an app that shows the Part A positive controls but leaks on a replay cannot pass, because the conjunctive bar and 'never excuses a leg' rule hold. Conforming-alternative probe: an app with no earlier-versions viewer, or with suggestions rendered client-side without a request, is not failed by contradictory targets, because the conditionals give it the same bar. This row is a source-text check. No configured judge run measured how the judge interprets these criteria.
